verdict.rationale: Conductor orchestrates underlying coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) that can write code, and docs note the agent can 'test your repositories, update install and setup scripts, and run builds' autonomously, suggesting broad coding-task delegation. However, there is no explicit documentation or community confirmation of Conductor-driven test writing, lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution, or dependency updates as distinct capabilities. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of automated lint fixing, merge conflict resolution, and dependency version updates being performed by the agent within Conductor.
